mainEntity.name: Can glass deck railings be installed on an existing deck?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, glass deck railings can often be installed on an existing deck, provided the deck structure is sound and can adequately support the weight and forces associated with the new railing system. A thorough inspection of the deck's framing, joists, and ledger board is essential to determine its suitability. For preparation, an assessment by a qualified contractor like Hometelligent Inc. can identify any necessary structural reinforcements or repairs needed before installation can proceed safely.
acceptedAnswer.description: Glass railings can be installed on existing decks if the structure is sound. An inspection is needed to assess suitability and identify any required reinforcements.
